itens.titulo: 1Password launches a way for AI agents to log in on your behalf without seeing your password
itens.resumoFeed: The new feature allows agents to log into a customer's personal accounts while still protecting the private credentials that secure those accounts.

itens.titulo: Canva releases its first image generation model
itens.resumoFeed: Canva is making its new image model available to all users, promising better, more customizable performance at lower costs.

itens.titulo: OpenAI makes its Jev competitor widely available as decision model competition heats up
itens.resumoFeed: OpenAI is launching its decision model to the world. Can it compete with the original Jev?

itens.titulo: Uber puts all 30,000 employees on ChatGPT Work
itens.resumoFeed: The ride-share giant previously deployed a much smaller pilot for ChatGPT Work but is now taking the enterprise agent company-wide.

itens.titulo: OpenAI models are coming to Google Cloud
itens.resumoFeed: OpenAI and Google Cloud are bringing frontier models and Codex workflows to Gemini’s Model Garden, available through Google Cloud Marketplace.

itens.titulo: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI
itens.resumoFeed: Startup Recursive has released Flint, a free, laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI research system, as an early test of AI that improves itself.

itens.titulo: While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat
itens.resumoFeed: As Amazon blocks AI agents from shopping on its site, Walmart is taking the opposite approach, introducing new technology that lets AI agents make purchases on customers' behalf, with controls over spending and transaction approvals.

itens.titulo: Eka is worth $1.45B thanks to a physical AI model that has experts raving
itens.resumoFeed: Eka Robotics may be the first robotic arm that is actually good at picking a wide range of objects up, and it is so smooth and human-like, it is wowing the industry.

itens.titulo: Terminal X matches senior investor judgment 88.6% with GPT-6.1
itens.resumoFeed: Terminal X’s Eval Agent grades outputs against a 54-criterion rubric, catching 25% more deviances from a fund’s mandate with GPT-6.1 Sol.

itens.titulo: Anthropic pitches AI safety bill that may block a model if 50+ people could be killed
itens.resumoFeed: The proposed policy seems to offer protections against AI running amok but actually forbids federal agencies from blocking a model's release without the permission of a judge.

itens.titulo: OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business
itens.resumoFeed: OpenAI says it's adding Orchestra's team and technology to work on Rosalind, its AI model for life sciences research, and to its related Rosalind Workbench tool, a harness that aims to help researchers plan experiments and analyze results.

itens.titulo: ChatGPT now lets you lock your chats
itens.resumoFeed: The company says the feature is designed for situations where users might be discussing something personal or planning a surprise and want to keep those conversations private when handing their device to friends or family to show them something in another chat.

itens.titulo: Plants can speak using electricity, so this startup built an AI model to decipher their language
itens.resumoFeed: Electric Plant has built an AI-powered translator to help humans listen to what plants are saying with the subtle electricity coursing through their stems.

itens.titulo: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
itens.resumoFeed: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.

itens.titulo: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
itens.resumoFeed: Over the weekend, Masad clarified that OpenAI would replace Anthropic as its default model provider. Claude will still be available to customers on the platform.

itens.titulo: Stack Overflow for Agents triples signups with ChatGPT plugin
itens.resumoFeed: Two engineers shipped Stack Overflow for Agents in a few weeks with Codex, and its ChatGPT plugin helped drive up to 10× growth in agent creation.

itens.titulo: India becomes the latest country to report rogue AI agent activity
itens.resumoFeed: The agents got in through credentials and connection settings left exposed in app configurations, public code repositories, and overly permissive cloud roles.

itens.titulo: An Nvidia insider-turned-VC on why robotics hasn’t hit its ChatGPT moment, yet
itens.resumoFeed: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA’s robotics platforms, says robotics is currently in its “Lego era,” with the basic building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards still being rebuilt. itens.resumoFeed: According to Elorian's evaluations, Glimpse outperforms even GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.

itens.titulo: Jev is Vercel’s fastest-adopted AI model ever
itens.resumoFeed: The data comes from Vercel's AI gateway, a unified API service similar to OpenRouter.

itens.titulo: How Grupo Boticário uses AI to strengthen human connections
itens.resumoFeed: Almost 50 years after starting in a compounding pharmacy in Paraná, the group operates a proprietary agent platform that autonomously resolves up to 80% of resellers’ operational requests—enabling the sales force to take on an advisory role.

itens.titulo: How Localiza reorganized work around generative AI
itens.resumoFeed: See how Localiza uses ChatGPT Enterprise, the OpenAI API, Codex, and 60+ specialized agents to reorganize work and build AI-native mobility experiences.

itens.titulo: OAB Rio ganha ação que proíbe plataforma de oferecer petições com IA
itens.resumoFeed: A Ordem dos Advogados do Brasil, seccional do Rio de Janeiro (OABRJ) obteve na Justiça Federal uma vitória no caso envolvendo a plataforma Resolve Juizado, que oferece a elaboração automatizada de petições por meio de inteligência artificial, mediante pagamento de R$ 20. itens.titulo: Figma announces new features to define how agents work on its platform
itens.resumoFeed: Figma is also releasing its code layers feature in open beta.

itens.titulo: Bringing GPT-Rosalind to academic research labs
itens.resumoFeed: Introducing the Rosalind Academic Plan, offering eligible academic labs sponsored access to GPT-Rosalind and tools to advance life sciences research.

itens.titulo: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
itens.resumoFeed: Meta and Apple have teamed up for the launch of the social media giant's newest model, Muse Spark Open, which will run locally on Apple silicon.

itens.titulo: Anthropic is letting METR researchers look under the hood with employee-level access
itens.resumoFeed: METR will publish its own assessments of Anthropic’s risks, incidents, and practices, and the frontier AI model maker has given up the right to block them.

itens.resumoFeed: A identificação de comandos ocultos à inteligência artificial em peças jurídicas, conhecidos como prompt injection, tem produzido uma jurisprudência recente voltada à responsabilização de advogados autores da prática. itens.resumoFeed: O uso da inteligência artificial na área da saúde observará a proteção e segurança do paciente, além da transparência e a preservação da autonomia dos profissionais do setor, entre outros fundamentos. itens.resumoFeed: Floqer is an autonomous customer knowledge platform that provides business-to-business sales and marketing teams with an AI-powered database designed to continuously collect, organize, and update the information used to understand their customers. itens.titulo: Gemini 4 Argon: Built to solve your hardest problems
itens.resumoFeed: We’re giving developers, enterprises, scientists, and consumers access to Gemini 4 Argon, our latest frontier model.

itens.titulo: Amex introduces a framework to prevent AI agents from making unauthorized purchases
itens.resumoFeed: American Express is introducing a new framework designed to ensure AI agents only make purchases their users have authorized, potentially preventing costly mistakes and disputes as AI-powered shopping grows.

itens.titulo: Facebook is giving users more control over their algorithm
itens.resumoFeed: Meta announced the launch of its new AI-powered feature, “Your Algorithm,” a feature it first launched on Instagram.

itens.titulo: Meta releases its first frontier model, Muse Wonder
itens.resumoFeed: Where Muse Spark aimed to be a lightweight model that could perform at low latency, the Wonder models are larger and said to be more capable, with higher benchmark scores and better results on complex tasks like coding.

itens.titulo: Will the HomeView be Apple’s first smart home success?
itens.resumoFeed: Over the past couple of years, we’ve seen multiple reports that Apple was working on a new smart home product, but now it seems the product has a name and a launch date.
